protocol.threshold: per-unit max calibration score, floored at log(1.05)
protocol.floor_note: Fixed exploratory minimum effect, not optimized or a significance level
protocol.regional_scenarios: three largest eligible regions by complete-panel municipality count
protocol.local_scenarios: 25% of eligible municipalities, three fixed seeds
protocol.status: exploratory reused archive, no independent temporal holdout

limits: Alarm rates on unlabelled real data are not false positive rates; three calibration months cannot establish reliability.
